business_name: Beachside Circle Boat Rentals and Sales
tagline: The Easiest Way to Get on the Water

about.description: Beachside Circle Boat Rentals and Sales is a local family-owned business offering portable, eco-friendly electric circle boat rentals on the waters of Orange Beach, Alabama. Their quiet, zero-emission inflatable circle boats are incredibly stable, virtually untippable, and require no boating license or prior experience. Guests can cruise no-wake zones, fish through canals, pull up to islands, or visit local waterfront restaurants. Boats launch from Romar Marina in Orange Beach (Cotton Bayou) and The Galley on The River in Gulf Shores (Bon Secour River). Single and double seater options are available, along with add-ons like towable floating docks, coolers, sunshade canopies, fishing poles, floating chairs, and pet-friendly doggie docks. Group rates available for 5+ single seaters.
about.elevator_pitch: Rent a portable, eco-friendly electric circle boat in Orange Beach — no license, no experience, just show up and cruise the Gulf Coast waterways in style.
about.vibe: Laid-back, eco-friendly, family fun on the water
about.capacity: Groups of 4+ boats can tie together; double seater fits 2 adults up to 450 lbs combined
about.departure_location: Romar Marina, 26350 Cotton Bayou Dr, Orange Beach, AL 36561 | The Galley on The River, 18546 Baldwin County Rd 10, Foley, AL 36535
about.age_restriction: Must be 21 to rent; drivers must be at least 14 years old
about.weight_restriction: Single seater: up to 300 lbs; Double seater: up to 450 lbs combined
about.reservations: Book online via website; group rates (5+ single seaters) must call to book
about.insider_tip: The seat on your Circle Boat pops off and works as a beach chair when you stop at the island.

packages.name: Mini Dock Rental
packages.description: Towable floating dock add-on for GoBoat rentals. 8'4" x 44", 100 lb capacity. Large flat platform for lounging and sunbathing. Tow it behind your circle boat to carry coolers, beach bags, chairs, umbrellas, or pets. EVA foam non-slip surface with quick-connect tow rope included.
packages.notes: Add-on to boat rental. Must be added at booking or check-in.

packages.name: X Dock Rental
packages.description: Compact square towable floating dock add-on. 5' x 5', 75 lb capacity. Designed to hold a full-size cooler (up to 58 quarts), tackle boxes, or a portable grill. Square shape is stable and stackable with raised edge rails to prevent items from sliding.
packages.notes: Add-on to boat rental. Recommended for carrying coolers — pair with a cooler rental add-on ($8).

packages.name: Doggie Dock Rental
packages.description: Pet-friendly towable floating dock add-on. 5'4" x 43", 85 lb capacity. Features a weighted mesh ramp so dogs can climb in and out of the water on their own. Non-slip surface keeps paws steady. Stays flat even with a jumping dog.
packages.notes: Pet-friendly add-on. Pairs great with the Pup Pack add-on (referenced on site but pricing not listed).

packages.name: Cooler Add-on
packages.description: Cooler rental add-on. Business provides the cooler; renter provides ice and snacks/drinks. Recommended to pair with X Dock rental to carry the cooler.
